promises.claim: on the Create Group details step a member picks a topic and gets distinct name suggestions, and one click fills the group name and description
one request never returns more than 50 suggestions, whatever count is sent
a failed or expired request shows an error with a Try again button instead of a silent empty grid
with BuddyPress or its Groups component off the plugin stays idle and shows an admin notice, never a fatal
the plugin stores no data, so deleting it leaves nothing behind
